outro_line.en: Thank you for listening. See you in the next story!
outro_line.ta: கதையைக் கேட்டதற்கு நன்றி. அடுத்த கதையில் சந்திப்போம்!

editorial_rules: Every story is warm, original and suitable for a general audience.
Never speak to the viewer as a child or as a parent of a child.
No graphic violence, cruelty, or unsafe behaviour shown as fun.
No brands, products, real people, places of worship or current events.
Use clear sentences and everyday words.

story.question_style: "What do you think happens next?" style questions for viewers

visuals.judge_criteria: Pick the picture that best matches the scene, keeps every character on model, looks warm and has no text in it.

music.mood_prompt: warm acoustic music with soft piano and light strings, calm and inviting

sound_effects.prompt_template: soft natural sound effect for an animated story: {cue}
